features.name: Three-valued (Kleene) semantics of and/or with an undefined operand

kk-modelvalidator.evidence: ocl/operation/BooleanOperationGroup.java and(Expression l, Expression r) = l.eq(booleanTrue).and(r.eq(booleanTrue)); or(...) similarly
